root_cause.title: A numeric value is divided by a variable that can be zero without a prior zero-guard, raising ZeroDivisionError at runtime.
root_cause.pattern: Division by a variable denominator with no zero-check before the `/` or `//` operator.
root_cause.why_it_breaks: When the denominator is zero Python raises ZeroDivisionError, crashing the caller. The caller has no opportunity to distinguish 'no data' from an error unless the function guards first.
trigger_conditions: An empty collection or dataset is passed (e.g. zero users, zero requests, zero items)
root_cause.fix_strategy: Return a safe sentinel value (0.0 or 0) when the denominator is zero before executing the division.
